note: Stage 3 opener: make ten (carrying addition). Three teaching scenes — nine apples plus four, move one to fill the ten frame, then the vertical sum with the carried ten highlighted. Answer phase: watch the fill and tap / drag apples to fill the ten frame / find the wrong sentence. No self-answer during the quiz.

lines.text: Look! Nine apples in the box, and four outside. Let's add them.
We move one apple to fill the ten! Now the box is full.
So, nine plus one is ten. And three more ones make thirteen.
When the ones are full, we make a new ten.
Eight apples in the box. Five more outside. How many in total?
Nine apples in the box. Three more outside. How many in total?
Nine apples in the box. Five more outside. How many in total?
Eight apples in the box. Seven more outside. How many in total?
Drag apples to fill the ten frame.
